name: (Special Forces) Dirty Fighting
text:
The special forces unit tries to disrupt the enemy's ability to fight back by disarming their weapons, kicking dust in their eyes, and so on. Attempt an Athletics check check against the Reflex DC of every enemy within a 5-foot emanation. On a success, that enemy takes a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls for 1 round, or if affecting a troop, a –2 circumstance penalty to that troop's DCs for damaging effects for 1 round. On a critical success, this penalty lasts for 2 rounds.

Effect: Dirty Fighting (Success)

Effect: Dirty Fighting (Critical Success)
